heading: Shipping Policy
intro: Arseen Enterprises LLC coordinates international shipment as part of its product procurement and order fulfillment services. Shipping coordination is not offered as a standalone transportation service. After procurement and order preparation are completed, orders are handed over to appropriate independent logistics providers based on destination, product type, and available shipping methods. Independent logistics providers perform the physical transportation and delivery of the goods. All delivery timeframes stated in this policy are estimates and begin after the order has been dispatched. By engaging our services, you acknowledge and agree to the terms outlined in this policy.

sections.title: Delivery Timeframes — Summary
sections.body: The following estimated total timeframes cover both order processing and delivery after dispatch. Express international: approximately 7–14 business days total. Standard international: approximately 12–20 business days total. Economy international: approximately 18–29 business days total. Specific estimates for your destination and order type will be stated in your written quotation. All timeframes are estimates, not guarantees. If your order has not arrived within the estimated timeframe, please contact us at support@arseenenterprises.com.

sections.title: Order Processing Before Dispatch
sections.body: Standard orders are typically processed in approximately 3–7 business days. Product sourcing or procurement orders may require approximately 5–10 business days. Customized, bulk, or complex orders will have a processing time stated in the written quotation. Processing time is separate from delivery time. Delivery estimates begin after the parcel has been dispatched. Customers will be notified if any delays are anticipated.

sections.title: Estimated Delivery After Dispatch
sections.body: Express international service: approximately 4–7 business days after dispatch. Standard international service: approximately 7–13 business days after dispatch. Economy international service: approximately 13–19 business days after dispatch. Typical destination estimates after dispatch: China to the United States approximately 4–7 business days; China to the United Kingdom approximately 7–13 business days; China to Canada approximately 7–13 business days; China to Australia approximately 7–13 business days; China to Europe approximately 7–13 business days; China to the Middle East approximately 7–13 business days. Estimates for other destinations will be provided in the customer quotation. All delivery periods are estimates rather than guarantees.

sections.title: Carrier Information
sections.body: Depending on the shipment, parcels may be transported by, transferred to, or delivered through established international or regional carrier networks, including DHL, FedEx, UPS, USPS (United States Postal Service), Royal Mail, Canada Post, Australia Post, China Post, EMS, YunExpress, 4PX, Cainiao, SF Express, Aramex, DPD, and other suitable providers. The availability of a carrier varies by route and order. Listing a carrier does not necessarily mean that Arseen Enterprises LLC has a direct contractual partnership with that carrier.

sections.title: Tracking Information
sections.body: Tracking information is normally provided after the shipment has been accepted and processed by the applicable logistics provider. Tracking activation may take approximately 24–72 hours after dispatch. Some economy services provide milestone tracking rather than continuous scans. If a tracking number has not been received within 48 hours of the expected dispatch date, please contact us at support@arseenenterprises.com.

sections.title: Independent Fulfillment Partners
sections.body: Orders may be fulfilled through trusted independent procurement, logistics, and fulfillment partners in China and other approved sourcing locations. These partners may assist with sourcing, inspection, packaging, dispatch, and coordination with international courier networks. Arseen Enterprises LLC does not claim ownership of every warehouse, shipping facility, courier network, or fulfillment location used to complete an order.

sections.title: Customs and Import Charges
sections.body: Customers are responsible for reviewing the import requirements of their destination country. Unless expressly included in the written quotation, customs duties, import taxes, brokerage fees, remote-area charges, and government assessments are payable by the recipient. Arseen Enterprises LLC may assist with reasonable shipment documentation but does not control customs authorities and cannot guarantee customs clearance. Delays caused by customs inspections or holds are outside our control.

sections.title: Delivery Estimates — Important Notice
sections.body: All delivery periods are estimates rather than guarantees. Actual delivery may be affected by customs clearance, security inspections, carrier congestion, weather, public holidays, remote destinations, inaccurate address information, recipient unavailability, import restrictions, or events outside our reasonable control. Arseen Enterprises LLC is not liable for delays caused by circumstances beyond our reasonable control.

sections.title: Lost or Damaged Shipments
sections.body: In the event that a shipment is lost or arrives damaged, customers must notify Arseen Enterprises LLC within 7 calendar days of the expected delivery date (for lost or non-delivered shipments) or within 5 calendar days of receipt (for damaged shipments). Notification must be sent to support@arseenenterprises.com and must include the order reference number, tracking number, a description of the issue, and photographic evidence of any damage. Arseen Enterprises LLC will initiate a carrier claim on the customer's behalf. Resolution timelines vary by carrier. Customers retain all rights to file a dispute with their payment provider if the matter is not resolved to their satisfaction.

sections.title: Non-Delivery Claims
sections.body: If your order has not been delivered within the estimated delivery timeframe stated in your quotation or in this policy, please contact us at support@arseenenterprises.com as soon as possible and no later than 30 calendar days after the estimated delivery date. We will investigate the shipment status and work to resolve the issue, including arranging a replacement or issuing a refund where applicable. Your right to file a dispute with your payment provider is not affected by this timeframe.

sections.title: Address Accuracy
sections.body: Customers are solely responsible for providing complete, accurate, and up-to-date shipping addresses at the time of order placement. Arseen Enterprises LLC will ship to the address provided and cannot be held responsible for delays, non-delivery, or additional costs resulting from incorrect, incomplete, or undeliverable addresses. If a shipment is returned due to an address error, the customer will be responsible for any re-shipment fees and applicable carrier return charges.

sections.title: Sanctions and Compliance
sections.body: Arseen Enterprises LLC does not knowingly accept transactions or arrange shipments involving sanctioned persons, prohibited counterparties, or jurisdictions prohibited under applicable sanctions requirements. Customer and destination information is reviewed before fulfillment in accordance with the Company's compliance procedures. Customers are responsible for ensuring that their orders, products, and intended destinations comply with all applicable export-control laws, sanctions regulations, and import restrictions. Arseen Enterprises LLC reserves the right to decline or cancel any shipment that it determines may present sanctions, export-control, or related compliance concerns.

sections.title: Contact Us
sections.body: For all shipping-related inquiries, including questions about order status, tracking, carrier selection, customs documentation, or claims for lost or damaged shipments, please contact us at support@arseenenterprises.com. Customer-support inquiries are normally answered within 1–2 business days. You may also reach us by mail at: Arseen Enterprises LLC, 15 Tanguay Ave, Suite 112 #7C, Nashua, NH 03063, United States (US Office Address).
